##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 5 (Great Saxon Uprising) triggers, generated by tools/gen_script_gsu.py
# England has 40 counties in the installed game; more than 75% is 31.
##########################################################################

# Character scope: the realm holds more than 75% of the counties of England.
eir_england_75_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 31
		kingdom = title:k_england
	}
}

# Title (duchy) scope, root = the ruler: a duchy of England under foreign occupation: its holder answers to the ruler,
# the ruler's realm holds half or more of its counties, and at least one of them is not Celtic.
eir_gsu_duchy_qualifies_trigger = {
	holder ?= { top_liege = root }
	any_de_jure_county = {
		percent >= 0.5
		holder ?= { top_liege = root }
	}
	any_de_jure_county = {
		eir_foreign_britain_county_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Character scope: at least two duchies of England qualify.
eir_gsu_duchies_trigger = {
	title:k_england = {
		any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
			count >= 2
			tier = tier_duchy
			eir_gsu_duchy_qualifies_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

# Character scope: the Uprising may break out now.
eir_gsu_ready_trigger = {
	eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
	is_ai = no
	is_independent_ruler = yes
	is_at_war = no
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_gsu_active }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_gsu_cooldown }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_gsu_done_2 }
	eir_england_75_trigger = yes
	eir_gsu_duchies_trigger = yes
}
